subject.title: Fix dashboard chat run recovery across reconnects

question: Should this stale external PR remain the canonical repair path for the paired Dashboard busy-state issue, or should maintainers ask for a current-main rewrite or replacement?
rationale: The branch is conflicting and touches superseded UI/protocol surfaces, so automation cannot safely choose whether to preserve, replace, or retire the contributor branch without maintainer intent.

options.title: Request current-main repair
options.body: Keep this PR open but require a rebase that fixes the listed shutdown, active-run filtering, protocol-package, fallback, and deterministic-recovery defects plus live Dashboard proof.

options.title: Adopt or replace
options.body: Have a maintainer or repair branch preserve the useful idea while rebuilding it on the current Control UI/Gateway architecture.

options.title: Close after canonical replacement
options.body: Close this PR only after a viable merged or proof-positive replacement owns the paired issue.

recommendation.title: Request current-main repair
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but require a rebase that fixes the listed shutdown, active-run filtering, protocol-package, fallback, and deterministic-recovery defects plus live Dashboard proof.
